name: BBR Saatchi & Saatchi
description: Leading Israeli advertising agency (Baumann Ber Rivnay) affiliated with Saatchi & Saatchi since 1995 and acquired by Publicis Groupe in 2012, when BBR employed 220 people. Named Globes Agency of the Year 2015; part of Publicis Groupe Israel, the country's largest communications group.
notable_work: Israir tribute to Yigal Bashan, AI work by studio T (2026)

key_people.name: Yoram Baumann
key_people.note: President of Publicis Groupe Israel leadership committee (2018)

key_people.name: Shani Shaul Vingosh
key_people.note: since Jan 2026; also CEO of Leo Burnett Israel

relations.note: 'Freedom to choose' message to the Iranian people with Beni Sabti, 2026-03 (ICE credits)

notes: Leadership per 2018 Publicis release; may have changed. Size band reflects 2012 headcount (220). Lotto account moved to Adler Chomski in Feb 2026. Effie Israel 2026 gold (Strauss Elite). bbr.co.il responds but had an expired TLS certificate on 2026-10-18. Website bbr.co.il unreachable as of 2026-10-19.
description_he: משרד פרסום ישראלי מוביל (באומן בר ריבנאי), המזוהה עם Saatchi & Saatchi מאז 1995 ונרכש על ידי Publicis Groupe ב-2012, כשהעסיק 220 עובדים. נבחר למשרד הפרסום של השנה של גלובס ב-2015; חלק מ-Publicis Groupe ישראל, קבוצת התקשורת הגדולה בארץ.
